blocks.text: Watch a video about Audit Logs (shows legacy UI).

Zscaler records the login name and IP address of every admin who logs in to the Zscaler Admin Console and changes policies or configuration settings. Audit logs display an admin's login and logout record and any actions (change configuration or policy) they performed. Audit logs are stored for up to 6 months.
Audit logs provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Monitor administrator activity in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Audit the log records and admin activities.

blocks.text: On the Audit Logs page (Data Explorer > Audit Logs > Mobile Administration), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for audit log records by resource, admin ID, or client IP address.
Export audit log records.
Show or hide columns in the table.
View and manage the filters applied to audit log records. The number displayed next to the filter icon indicates the number of active filters.
Apply filters to view specific information. After selecting the filter criteria, select the apply filters button to display the matching audit log records.
Clear all applied filters and reset to the default page view. The reset button appears after you apply filters.
View the audit logs. For each record, you can see:
Timestamp: The local time of the admin's last login or last logout.
Action: The action (create, delete, sign in, sign out, and update) performed by the admin.
Category: The module in which the action was performed.
Subcategory: The specific section in the module.
Resource: The specific configuration item associated with the action performed by the admin.
Admin ID: The admin's login ID.
Client IP: The source IP address of the client.
Result: The outcome of the action performed by the admin.
View the configuration changes for each action.
Compare the configuration before and after a change:
View updates: Displays modifications to existing configurations.
See image.
View additions and deletions: Displays configuration items that were added or deleted.
See image.
